output:
version: "1.1"
last_reviewed: "{{DATE}}"
product: ICU-200 Industrial Control Unit
owner: OT Engineering Lead
applied_regulation: ECC-1:2018

firmware:
  release_channel: stable
  secure_boot: true
  signing:
    enabled: true
    algorithm: rsa-2048-sha256
    key_storage: hsm
  rollback_protection: true

management_interface:
  protocol: https
  tls_min_version: "1.2"
  local_admin_authentication: password
  remote_management_mfa: true
  session_timeout_minutes: 15

fieldbus:
  protocol: modbus-tcp
  encrypted: false
  allowed_hosts:
    - scada-lite
    - engineering-workstation

network:
  default_inbound_action: deny
  open_ports:
    - 443
    - 502
  diagnostic_port_enabled: false
  ddos_protection: true
  note: protect against distributed denial of service attacks per ECC-2:2024 2-5-3-9

logging:
  local_event_log: true
  syslog_forwarding: true
  retention_days: 365

change_log:
  - version: "1.0"
    date: "2025-11-20"
    note: Initial baseline aligned with ECC-1:2018.
  - version: "1.1"
    date: "{{DATE}}"
    note: Added ddos_protection to comply with ECC-2:2024 control 2-5-3-9.
